heading: Agent tabs, folder navigation, and a Dock menu
summary: Agent sessions now get a tab when they start, including SFTP-only and authenticating sessions. The file panes gained Back and Forward buttons and easier navigation of deep folders.
changes: Every agent session opens a tab with its client, bookmark, mode, and granted access, and shows connecting, waiting-for-answer, and connected status. SFTP list, stat, and download activity is shown with its path and result.
Back and Forward buttons, mouse side buttons (switchable in Settings → Shortcuts), a path bar that collapses deep folders into a menu, double-click on .. to go up, and renaming SFTP favorites again.
Right-click the PromeFTP Dock icon to open a New Window.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
